from.place: Proper and affine cases: compatibility of Kummer exact sequences, degree maps, and pullback under k ⊂ k'

title: Kummer sequences and affine Picard torsion commute with algebraically closed base change
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension of algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], let $C$ be a smooth separated connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], and let $n\geq1$ be prime to $\operatorname{char}k$. Under the canonical pullback maps, the Kummer long exact sequences [lem-sc-kummer-les] for $C$ and $C_{k'}$ form a commutative morphism of exact sequences. If $C$ is affine, then pullback induces an isomorphism $\operatorname{Pic}(C)[n]\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Pic}(C_{k'})[n]$.
